step.content: {"order":"CD-420458","goal":"Tell the branch that Bahn is asking the customer to clear the seller hold and have the seller email the signed release to werkstatt@calverona.example, no driver will be sent before the branch confirms; confirm the address and that they will tell us when it arrives. Agree no cost, date or booking.","language":"de"}

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Calverona Hamburg, Werkstatt, Lukas Brandt am Apparat. Was kann ich für Sie tun?
turns.translation: Calverona Hamburg, workshop, Lukas Brandt speaking. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Guten Tag Herr Brandt, hier ist der digitale Assistent von Bahn, es geht um den Ferrari Roma, Auftrag CD-420458. Auf dem Wagen liegt eine Verkäufersperre, wir bitten den Kunden, sie aufzuheben und die unterschriebene Freigabe per E-Mail an werkstatt@calverona.example schicken zu lassen; bis Sie bestätigen, schicken wir keinen Fahrer. Passt die Adresse so?
turns.translation: Good day Mr. Brandt, this is Bahn's digital assistant, regarding the Ferrari Roma, order CD-420458. There is a seller hold on the car; we are asking the customer to clear it and have the signed release emailed to werkstatt@calverona.example, and until you confirm, we won't send a driver. Is the address correct like that?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Ja, die Adresse passt: werkstatt@calverona.example. Bis die unterschriebene Freigabe des Verkäufers dort ankommt und die Sperre aufgehoben ist, geben wir den Ferrari nicht heraus.
turns.translation: Yes, the address is correct: werkstatt@calverona.example. Until the seller's signed release arrives there and the hold is lifted, we won't hand over the Ferrari.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Vielen Dank, Herr Brandt. Würden Sie uns dann bitte Bescheid geben, sobald die Freigabe bei Ihnen eingetroffen ist? Bis dahin schicken wir keinen Fahrer.
turns.translation: Thank you, Mr. Brandt. Would you then please let us know as soon as the release has arrived? Until then we won't send a driver.

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Ob wir Ihnen dann Bescheid geben, müsste ich erst klären, das kann ich Ihnen jetzt nicht zusagen. Melden Sie sich am besten bei uns, wenn die Freigabe verschickt ist, dann schaue ich nach, ob sie angekommen ist.
turns.translation: Whether we can notify you then, I would have to check first, I can't promise that right now. It's best if you contact us once the release has been sent, then I'll check whether it has arrived.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alles klar, Herr Brandt, dann melden wir uns bei Ihnen, sobald die Freigabe verschickt ist, und Sie schauen dann nach. Vielen Dank für Ihre Hilfe, auf Wiederhören!
turns.translation: Alright, Mr. Brandt, then we'll contact you once the release has been sent, and you'll check then. Thank you for your help, goodbye!

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Genau, so machen wir das. Auf Wiederhören, Herr oder Frau von Bahn!
turns.translation: Exactly, that's how we'll do it. Goodbye, to you at Bahn!

case.headline: The Ferrari Roma is at the branch, but the seller's hold is on and the signed release is missing, so the branch will refuse the driver.

facts.statement: The branch needs the seller's signed release sent by email to werkstatt@calverona.example before it can release the Ferrari Roma.
The seller has put a hold on the Ferrari because of an open invoice.
No signed release from the seller has arrived at the branch for the Ferrari.
Release document on the order: missing, required, no file.
The branch asked that no driver be sent.
The branch could not say by what time the release must arrive and would have to check.

The branch's answer at 09:01 today matches its 08:38 message and the customer's emails: the car is present, but the hold and missing release block handover. The customer on 19 Oct said the release might come that afternoon; nothing has arrived since.
No driver is booked and the gig is not published, so nothing needs undoing. The pickup slot is Mon 26 Oct 10:00 to 13:00 Berlin time, 120 hours away.
The pickup place confirmed that the correct email address for the signed release is werkstatt@calverona.example.
The pickup place said it will not hand over the Ferrari until the seller's signed release has arrived at that address and the hold is lifted.
The pickup place said it cannot promise now to notify Bahn when the release arrives and would have to check first.
The pickup place asked Bahn to contact them once the release has been sent, and said they will then check whether it has arrived.
The pickup place agreed that Bahn will contact them once the release has been sent and that they will check then.

agentSteps.summary: Checked the trust rules: none is ON.

Called Calverona Hamburg in German. The branch needs the seller's signed release by email and the open-invoice hold lifted before handing over the Ferrari, none has arrived, no driver should be sent, and the deadline before Monday 10:00 is unknown.

Will follow up at Wed 21 Oct 12:00 local time: Check whether the person decided and whether the seller hold and signed release have reached the branch. Bahn promised the branch an answer within the hour.

Called Calverona Hamburg in German. The branch confirmed the release email address and that the car stays held until the release arrives, but would not promise to notify Bahn; Bahn is to contact them once the release is sent and they will check then.

Please do this by Friday 23 October so we can still book a driver. We will not send a driver before the branch confirms.

Never send a driver while the pickup place says the handover will be refused.

changes.detail: No change. Gig stays unpublished, pickup stays unconfirmed.

whyChoices: The customer has already been asked twice, so a third message may add nothing.
The customer said the release might arrive soon.
There is no cost or date change while we wait.

step.name: resolve_without_person

step.content:

No driver is booked, and none goes until the branch confirms. The customer message asks for the hold and release by Fri 23 Oct. A person still has to send that message.
